title: 第十七章　代价
content_zh:
其实跟在所爱之人的身后，又有谁会介意呢！

    唯一会介意的可能就是，永远看不到对方真诚的眼神。

    艾妮尔和萨尔回到Ａ区的酒馆里，除了艾勒维格他们四位之外，谁也不在，更别说正好是艾妮尔想找麻烦的爱夏了。

    “就你们？”艾妮尔冷冷的瞟了艾勒维格他们一眼。

    “还有你们。”艾勒维格阴笑两声，他可不怕这个长不大的女孩子，虽然冷，但是比起这里的那些贵族，完全不可怕。

    “他们呢？”艾妮尔在一旁的那个桌子前坐下，扫了一眼桌上零散的酒杯，“被水怪吃了？”

    “哈哈～”多力忍不住笑出了声，不过尼克他们毕竟教老练的多，面色只是微微的一变，没有什么表露。

    “他们都执行任务去了。”爱夏突然从艾妮尔他们刚才的方向走了进来，拍了拍裙角上的尘土，“如果你们想去的话……”

    “不用了。”爱夏的话还没有说完，艾妮尔冷笑着起身，“我有事找你。”

    “哦？艾妮尔小姐找我有什么事啊？难道说同意我先前的提议了？”爱夏得意的向艾妮尔走去，眼睛不断的向艾妮尔身旁的萨尔丢着眼色。

    “提议？”艾妮尔一顿，一把抓住爱夏的领子，“也许！”

    “你……”爱夏发现不对，可是想要挣脱为时以晚，只觉着整个身子正以风一般的速度向门外飞去，吸血鬼的超强感觉瞬间便嗅到了危险，“不～”

    “你可以把这个当成一个游戏。”此时的艾妮尔，对于爱夏来说，当初那平静而冰冷的声音，在这一刻尤其显得阴沉恐怖，最后是嘴角那一抹血色的微笑，就像一个地狱里的魔鬼。

    “不～”爱夏还在惊慌失措的大叫，门已经开了，阳光顺着打开的空间，直线射了进来，首先照到的是爱夏身前的艾妮尔，可是她却在笑着，笑的爱夏心里发毛，接着自然就是爱夏，在如此快的速度之下，爱夏完全暴露在了阳光中，充满痛苦的惨叫声随即传来，“啊~”

    “艾妮尔！”萨尔有些看不下去，一把拉住了爱夏，将她拽离了艾妮尔的双手。

    “萨尔你……”艾妮尔回头，瞪着这个自己的同伴，面色有些阴霾。

    “够了！”萨尔将爱夏拉到自己的身后，用自己的身体尽可能的挡着迎面射来的阳光，“艾妮尔！够了！”

    再一次的严厉喝声，让艾妮尔一愣，可是那淡淡的茫然转瞬即逝，艾妮尔冷笑一声，“原来你也想玩游戏啊！行！不过得换个游戏，这个对你来说太没意思。”

    “艾……”看着越走越近的艾妮尔，萨尔只觉得四周的阳光变得冰冷，压抑的喘过不气来。

    结果艾妮尔就在与他鼻尖对鼻尖的地方向外移出了一步，最后停在爱夏的旁身，带着淡淡冷冷的笑，“你的提议……我同意了！”

    “你……”结果对方却不相信，瞪着一双警惕的眼睛，盯着艾妮尔，眼中的血色闪动不停。

    “你不同意？”艾妮尔继续那么笑着，而她越是这么笑，这么的没有敌意，爱夏就越是不相信，越是害怕，“我……我……”

    “既然你不同意，那就算了，我想Ｆ区也不是那么难找。”说着，艾妮尔直步走进对面的酒馆，“艾勒维格，如果不想喂水怪，就快点帮我寻找Ｆ区的入口。”

    “什么？喂水怪？”一旁的多力听着只觉得汗毛直竖，手中的杯子砰的落回了桌面，杯中原来平静的酒被震出了不少，四周充斥着烈酒的刺鼻味，可是这种时候，听到这个话，还有谁会去在意这小小的酒气。

    “哼！也许还有些别的东西。”已经走进了后面房间的艾妮尔远远的飘来这么一句。

    “艾妮尔～”多力想要问个清楚，可是对方再也没有回应。

    “艾勒维格……我们……”尼克也觉得有些不太对劲，放下酒杯起了身。

    “既然我们的首领下了命令，我们为什么不执行呢！”艾勒维格起身整了整衣服，转身向那道通向房间的门走去，多力他们自然是无话的跟随。

    “你不来吗？”艾勒维格在踏出门的那一刻，还不忘回头望了一眼愣在那里的萨尔。

    “我……”萨尔一惊，醒了过来。

    “如果把艾妮尔惹火了，那可就真的gameover了。”
content_en:
In fact, who would mind following behind the one you love?

    The only thing that may bother you is that you will never see the sincere eyes of the other party.

    Enel and Sal returned to the tavern in Area A. Except for Ellerweg and the four of them, no one was there, let alone Aisha, who happened to be Enel and wanted to cause trouble.

    "Just you?" Enel glanced at Ellevig and the others coldly.

    "And you." Ellevig chuckled sinisterly. He was not afraid of this young girl. Although she was cold, she was not scary at all compared to the nobles here.

    "Where are they?" Enel sat down at the table nearby and glanced at the scattered wine glasses on the table, "Were they eaten by the water monster?"

    "Haha~" Duoli couldn't help laughing, but Nick and the others were more experienced teachers after all, so their expressions only changed slightly, without revealing anything.

    "They have all gone on a mission." Aisha suddenly walked in from the direction Enel and the others were just walking in, patting the dust on the corners of her skirts, "If you want to go..."

    "No need." Before Ai Xia finished speaking, Enel stood up with a sneer, "I have something to ask you."

    "Oh? What do you want Miss Anel to do with me? Do you think you agree with my previous proposal?" Aisha walked towards Anel proudly, her eyes constantly casting glances at Sal next to Anel.

    "Proposal?" Enel paused and grabbed Aisha's collar, "Maybe!"

    "You..." Ai Xia realized something was wrong, but it was too late to break away. She felt that her whole body was flying out of the door at the speed of the wind. The vampire's super sense instantly smelled danger, "No~"

    "You can think of this as a game." At this moment, Enel, to Aisha, the calm and cold voice at the beginning seemed particularly gloomy and terrifying at this moment, and finally the bloody smile on the corner of her mouth, like a devil in hell.

    "No~" Ai Xia was still yelling in panic. The door had been opened, and the sunlight came straight in along the open space. The first thing that hit Ai Xia was Enel in front of Ai Xia, but she was smiling, which made Ai Xia's heart go crazy. Then of course it was Ai Xia. At such a fast speed, Ai Xia was completely exposed to the sunlight, and a painful scream came out, "Ah~"

    "Enel!" Sal couldn't stand it anymore. He grabbed Aisha and pulled her away from Enel's hands.

    "Sal, you..." Enel turned around and stared at her companion, her expression a little gloomy.

    "That's enough!" Sal pulled Aisha behind him and used his body to block the incoming sunlight as much as possible, "Enel! That's enough!"

    Another stern shout made Anel stunned for a moment, but the faint confusion disappeared in an instant. Anel sneered, "So you also want to play a game! Okay! But you have to change the game. This is too boring for you."

    "Ai..." Looking at Enel getting closer and closer, Sal felt that the sunlight around him had become cold, and he was so depressed that he couldn't breathe.

    As a result, Enel took a step forward from the tip of his nose to his nose, and finally stopped next to Aisha, with a faint and cold smile, "Your proposal... I agree!"

    "You..." But the other party didn't believe it. He stared at Enel with a pair of vigilant eyes, the blood in his eyes flashing non-stop.

    "You don't agree?" Enel continued to smile like that, and the more she smiled like this and showed no hostility, the more Ai Xia didn't believe it and became more scared, "I...I..."

    "Since you don't agree, forget it. I think Area F is not that hard to find." With that said, Enel walked straight into the tavern opposite. "Ellevig, if you don't want to feed the water monster, please help me find the entrance to Area F quickly."

    "What? Feed the water monster?" Duoli on the side felt his hair stand up as he listened. The cup in his hand slammed back to the table. A lot of the calm wine in the cup was shaken out, and the surroundings were filled with the pungent smell of strong liquor. But at this time, after hearing this, who would care about the small smell of alcohol.

    "Hmph! Maybe there is something else." Enel, who had already walked into the back room, said this from a distance.

    "Anel~" Duoli wanted to ask clearly, but the other party never responded.

    "Ellevig...we..." Nick also felt that something was not right, so he put down his wine glass and stood up.

    "Since our leader gave the order, why don't we execute it!" Ellevig stood up, straightened his clothes, turned around and walked towards the door leading to the room. Doli and the others naturally followed without saying a word.

    "Aren't you coming?" The moment Ellevig stepped out of the door, he didn't forget to look back at Sal who was stunned.

    "I..." Sal was startled and woke up.

    "If Enel is angered, it will really be a gameover."
